units: positions in mm and in LDU (2.5 LDU per mm), in the part's own frame
frame: origin at the product centre; -Y out of the screen, +Y out of the back; +X toward the side-button edge; +Z toward the top (receiver) end

extent.note: Y runs from the screen to the top of the lens rings (7.8 + 1.68)

window.note: centre of the lens window, drawn flush with the ring top (its depth is not given)

coneApex.source: derived: sheet 2, Section L-L: 82° REAR CAMERA KEEPOUT CONE from its Ø5.91 BASE OF KEEPOUT CONE CONTACTING LENS COVER (1.68 + 7.80 = 9.48 from the front): 9.48 - 2.955 / tan 41°
coneApex.note: the keepout cone's apex: the drawing's own optical reference; the lens's entrance pupil is near it but not given

keepoutCone.source: dimensioned: sheet 2, Section L-L: 82° REAR CAMERA KEEPOUT CONE
keepoutCone.note: nothing of a mount may enter this cone from its apex: a design check, not the field of view

fieldOfView.source: derived from spec: 48MP Fusion Main: 26 mm, ƒ/1.6 aperture
fieldOfView.note: pinhole model of the 4:3 still; the image's long side runs along the phone's length (Z). Video (16:9) crops the short side

sources.fromSide: dimensioned: sheet 1, Detail D: 13.32 (the camera's centre, across)
sources.fromTop: dimensioned: sheet 1, Detail D: 3X -13.32 (the camera's, the rear mic's and the flash's centres)

cameras.identity: inferred: the only rear camera: the Fusion (spec); its 82° cone encloses a 26 mm lens's 79.5° diagonal

sources: dimensioned: sheet 1, Detail D: 3X -13.32 (the camera's, the rear mic's and the flash's centres)

apexFromFront.source: derived: sheet 2, Section N-N: not dimensioned; the 80° cone through its Ø6.00 base on the back glass: 7.80 - 3.00 / tan 40° = 4.225

innerConeDeg.source: dimensioned: sheet 2, Section N-N: 80° FLASH INNER KEEPOUT CONE (the only section through the flash, so taken as circular)

outerConeDeg.source: dimensioned: sheet 2, Section N-N: 155° FLASH OUTER KEEPOUT CONE

transitionFromFront.source: derived: sheet 2, Section N-N: 0.82 FLASH KEEPOUT CONE TRANSITION TO BACK GLASS (its arrows on the back glass's face and the kinks' extension line), so 7.80 + 0.82 from the front

outerApexFromFront.source: derived: sheet 2, Section N-N: not dimensioned; the 155° cone through the Ø7.37 transition: 8.62 - 3.685 / tan 77.5° = 7.803, on the back glass's face

innerBaseDiameter.source: dimensioned: sheet 2, Section N-N: 6.00 DIAMETER OF KEEPOUT CONE BASE CONTACTING REAR GLASS (its extension lines on the inner cone's corners on the back glass's face, 7.80 from the front)

keepout.note: cones about the flash's axis, their apex inside the phone, measured from the front (screen) face as the section dimensions them

sources: dimensioned: sheet 1, Detail D: 24.30 (the ordinate above the view; its extension line comes down to the mic's centre)
dimensioned: sheet 1, Detail D: 3X -13.32 (the camera's, the rear mic's and the flash's centres)
dimensioned: sheet 1, Detail D: [2] Ø1.30 REAR MIC (its arrow lands on the outer of two concentric circles)
dimensioned: sheet 2, MagSafe view: 35.76 PRODUCT CENTER (71.52 / 2)
dimensioned: sheet 2, MagSafe view: -73.35 PRODUCT CENTER (146.71 / 2 = 73.355)

clear.source: dimensioned: sheet 2, MagSafe view: Ø57.50 (its leader on the clear area's circle; measure.ts fits the circle round the product centre)
clear.note: keep clear of metal, conductive or magnetic material

magsafe.note: on the back glass, about the axis out of the back

mass.note: centre of mass not given; the product centre is an assumption
